selection: Fully scored development candidates only; minimize false passes then maximize agreement; ties prefer v2; record choice before scoring holdout. No holdout tuning.
native_alignment: SimpleLLMMetric.align with embedding_model=None uses native recent-example fallback, not semantic retrieval or model weight training
labels: Instructor scalar contract records, no actual Agent execution or independent human vote claimed
self_preference: Unverified origin cue only; exact judge identity and actual report origins are unknown, so no model self-preference conclusion
retry_policy: No reroll or best-of; errors remain unscored; native stage failure preserves successful partial calls
